players.bio: Adam Holroyd (born 5 September 2004) is a professional rugby league footballer who plays as a Hooker for the Warrington Wolves in the Super League. In 2022 Holroyd made his début for Warrington in the Super League against the Leeds Rhinos. On 7 June 2025, Holroyd played in Warrington's 8-6 Challenge Cup final loss against Hull Kingston Rovers.

Albert Hopoate (born 25 February 2001) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays as a winger or centre for the Warrington Wolves in the Super League. He previously played for the Manly Warringah Sea Eagles in the NRL.
Arron Lindop (born 17 March 2006) is an English professional rugby league footballer who plays as a winger and centre for the Warrington Wolves in Super League.

Ben Currie (born 15 July 1994) is a professional rugby league footballer who plays as a second-row or centre for the Warrington Wolves in the Super League. Currie played his junior rugby at Golborne Parkside before signing with Warrington Wolves. He made his début for Warrington in April 2012, aged 17, in a 46–12 win against Widnes Vikings.

Cai Taylor-Wray (born 24 Feburay 2006) is an English professional rugby league footballer who plays as a fullback for the Warrington Wolves in the Betfred Super League. He has spent time on loan from Warrington at the Widnes Vikings in the RFL Championship.[

Danny Walker (born 29 June 1999) is an English professional rugby league footballer who plays as a hooker for the Warrington Wolves in the Super League and both England and the England Knights at international level. He played for the Widnes Vikings in the Super League, and has spent time on loan from Warrington at the Rochdale Hornets in the Championship.

George Williams (born 31 October 1994) is an English professional rugby league footballer who plays as a scrum-half and stand-off for Warrington Wolves in the Super League and England at international level. Williams made his senior début for the Wigan Warriors in 2013.

Jake Thewlis (born 24 May 2005) is a professional rugby league footballer who plays as a winger for the Warrington Wolves in the Betfred Super League. He has spent time on loan from Warrington at the North Wales Crusaders in Betfred League 1, as well as at the London Broncos in the RFL Championship and the Salford Red Devils in the Super League.

James Bentley (born 19 October 1997) is an Ireland international rugby league footballer who plays as a second-row, loose forward or hooker for Warrington Wolves in the Super League. He played for the Bradford Bulls in the Championship.

James Harrison (born 15 June 1996) is a rugby league footballer who plays as a second-row, prop or loose forward for the Warrington Wolves in the Super League. He previously played for Featherstone Rovers and had two spells at the Batley Bulldogs all in the Championship, and played at Oxford in League 1 when on loan from Batley .

Joe Philbin (born 16 November 1994) is a professional rugby league footballer who plays as a loose forward, second-row and prop for the Warrington Wolves in the Super League. He has played for Ireland, Great Britain and the England Knights at international level.

Jordan Crowther (born 19 February 1997) is an English rugby league footballer who plays as a loose forward and hooker for Warrington Wolves in the Super League. He has spent time on loan from Wakefield (Heritage № 1339) at the York City Knights, Oxford and Newcastle Thunder in League 1, and the Dewsbury Rams in the Championship.

Josh Thewlis (born 30 April 2002) is an English rugby league footballer who plays as a fullback or winger for the Warrington Wolves in the Super League. Thewlis made his Super League debut for Warrington in their 34–4 victory over the Catalans Dragons in round 17 of the 2019 Super League season.
Kelepi Tanginoa (born 1 March 1994) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays as a prop, second-row forward and loose forward for Warrington Wolves in the Super League.

Leon Hayes (born 4 March 2004) is an English professional rugby league footballer who plays as a scrum-half for the Warrington Wolves in the Betfred Super League. He has spent time on loan from Warrington at the West Wales Raiders in Betfred League 1 and at North Wales Crusaders in 2023 In 2022 Hayes made his début for the Wire in the Super League against the Huddersfield Giants

Liam Byrne (born 18 August 1999) is an Ireland international rugby league footballer who plays as a prop forward for the Warrington Wolves in the Super League. He has spent time on loan from Wigan at Workington Town in the Betfred League 1, as well as the Leigh Centurions and the Swinton Lions in the Championship.

Luke Thomas (born 19 October 2002) is a Wales international rugby league footballer who plays as a prop for Warrington Wolves in the Super League. He has also spent time on loan from Warrington at the Rochdale Hornets in League 1.

Luke Yates (born 6 March 1995) is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who plays as a loose forward and prop for Warrington Wolves in the Betfred Super League, on initial loan from Huddersfield Giants. He previously played for the Newcastle Knights in the NRL and the London Broncos in the Super League.

Marc Sneyd (born 9 February 1991) is an English professional rugby league footballer who plays as a scrum-half for Warrington Wolves in the Super League and England at international level.[ He previously played for the Castleford Tigers and the Salford Red Devils. Having come through the club's junior ranks, Sneyd made his début for Salford in 2010, playing 6 games.

Matty Ashton (born 28 July 1998) is a professional rugby league footballer who plays as a fullback for the Warrington Wolves in the Betfred Super League. He previously played for the Swinton Lions in the Betfred Championship. He made his England debut against France on 29 April 2023.

Max Wood (born 28 June 2004) is an English professional rugby league footballer who plays as a prop for the Warrington Wolves in the Betfred Super League. He was contracted to the Wigan Warriors in the Super League, and spent time on loan from Wigan at the Midlands Hurricanes in Betfred League 1.

Oli Leyland (born 17 May 2001) is an English professional rugby league footballer who plays as a stand-off, scrum-half or fullback for the Warrington Wolves in the Super League. He has spent time on loan from the Broncos at the London Skolars in League 1.

Samuel Burgess (born 14 December 1988) is an English professional rugby league coach who is the head coach of the Warrington Wolves in the Betfred Super League, and former professional rugby league footballer who played as a loose forward, prop or second-row forward in the 2000s and 2010s.

Sam Powell (born 3 July 1992) is an English rugby league footballer who plays as a scrum-half or hooker for the Warrington Wolves in the Super League and the England Knights at international level. He has spent time on dual-registration from Wigan with Workington Town in the Championship and with the South Wales Scorpions in League 1.

Sam Stone (born 4 August 1997) is a Malta international rugby league footballer who plays as a second-row forward for the Warrington Wolves in the Super League. He previously played for the Newcastle Knights and Gold Coast Titans in the NRL.

Toafofoa Sipley (born 5 January 1995) is a Niue international rugby league footballer who plays as a prop for the Warrington Wolves in the Super League. He previously played for the New Zealand Warriors in the NRL. He previously played for the New Zealand Warriors in the National Rugby League.

Toby King (born 9 July 1996) is a professional rugby league footballer who plays as a centre for the Warrington Wolves. He has played for Ireland, England and the England Knights at international level. He made his England debut on 29 April 2023 in the 64-0 victory over France at the Halliwell Jones Stadium He has spent time on loan from Warrington at the Rochdale Hornets in the Championship.
